notes: Access: direct fetch and r.jina.ai both hit a Cloudflare 'managed challenge' JS interstitial (HTTP 429/403, 'Verifying your connection...'/'Just a moment...'). Bypassed with curl_cffi browser impersonation (impersonate='chrome124'), which succeeded immediately on HTML pages and all Shopify JSON endpoints (/collections.json, /collections/<handle>/products.json, /sitemap.xml). robots.txt fetched cleanly via the same route: no Claude-specific group (ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User absent); only '*', adsbot-google, Nutch (full site disallow, irrelevant), AhrefsBot, AhrefsSiteAudit, MJ12bot, Pinterest groups exist, none of which restrict the /collections paths used here. Shopify shop_id 52874805443. Merci is a general Paris concept store (fashion, beauty, books/stationery, toys, furniture, bedding/bath textiles, tableware, and home decor/lighting all under one roof) confirmed via the full top-nav megamenu (11 branches: Wonder Merci, New In, Le Lit, Le Bain, La Table, Mode Femme, Mode Homme, Enfants, Deco & lifestyle, Beaute, Meubles) - scoped strictly to home-decor-relevant branches per the brief's INCLUDE/EXCLUDE list. All qty values are exhaustive unique-product-ID counts from Shopify's own /products.json?limit=250 pagination (never the unreliable products_count field), single page in every case (<250 returned, confirms exhaustion). EXCLUDED wholesale: Le Lit (bedding/textiles), Mode Femme/Mode Homme (fashion/jewelry/shoes/bags), Beaute (cosmetics/fragrance), Enfants (toys/kids clothing/kids bedding), New In and Wonder Merci ('exposition-souvenirs-de-paris', a 298-product mixed thematic Paris-souvenir/gift-shop collection spanning bags/toys/stationery/candles/ceramics - a promotional/exhibition rollup, not a product-type category, dropped per NEVER EXTRACT). Meubles (furniture: sofas, storage, seating, tables) verified via keyword scan of all 134 products for lamp/mirror/clock/vase/candle-holder terms - zero hits, safely excluded whole. Within Le Bain: towels/bathrobes/bath mats (textiles) and the 'Par matiere' facet cut excluded; /collections/accessoires (131 products, the bloc's 'Voir tout' link) is a parent aggregate = the 45-product accessoires-salle-de-bain set plus toiletry pouches/wash bags (fashion accessories) - dropped as a Rule-0.6 duplicate aggregate, not extracted separately. Within La Table: table linen (nappes/serviettes/sets de table/dessous-de-verre-en-lin/tabliers/torchons/cabas - textiles), Couverts (cutlery), and Cuisine & ustensiles (cookware/utensils) all excluded per brief; 'Nos Collections' (Merci x Serax, Cosi Tabellini) dropped as brand-listing pages. Within Deco & lifestyle: Decoration textile (curtains/home linen/cushions/throws), Quincaillerie (cleaning/food/storage/matches), and Lifestyle (books/stationery/gadgets/outdoor gear) all excluded. 'Bougies & senteurs' (159 products) is Home Fragrance - actual titles are dominated by 'Bougie parfumee' (scented candle), 'Parfum d'interieur' (reed diffuser/interior fragrance), 'Spray d'interieur', 'Brume vegetale' (mist) - excluded wholesale per brief's Home Fragrance exclusion (scented candles/diffusers/sprays read from actual titles). Rule 0.6 note: /collections/art-de-vivre (314 products) is the parent 'Decoration' aggregate for Wall Art/Vases/Mirrors/Bougies/Horloges; diffing its product-ID set against the 5 nav-linked children surfaced 99 additional untagged products, title-classified as 41 candle holders ('Bougeoir'/'Chandelier' - genuinely decorative, IN SCOPE, verified to exactly match the separately-reachable but nav-unlinked /collections/bougeoirs page) plus 58 cushions/throws/blankets/bedspreads (textiles, excluded). Horloges collection (20 raw) contained 1 non-clock 'Thermo-Hygrometre' item, excluded by title, leaving 19 clocks/alarm clocks. Accessoires de salle de bain (45 raw, Le Bain > Accessoires bloc) is a genuine mixed roll-up per the brief's own guidance ('drop, don't pad - inspect actual titles'): manually classified by title into 17 decorative wall hooks (patere/crochet in porcelain/wood/aluminum/brass), 2 decorative trays/dishes (bath tray; jewelry dish), 1 magnifying mirror, vs. 25 excluded bath fixtures/storage (soap dishes/dispensers, toothbrush holders/stands) and personal-care items (toothbrushes, nail clippers, back scratcher, bath salts) - confirmed via product-ID diff that the magnifying mirror is NOT a duplicate of the 2 items already counted under the standalone Miroirs collection. No duplicate-company flag for this S.N.; no prior Merci precedent in this project.
